blocks.text: Welcome to 2nspira LLC (“we,” “us,” “our”). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your data when you visit our website (the “Site”), subscribe to our blog, book our services, or purchase service plans.
By using our Site or services, you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please discontinue use.

When you purchase, subscribe, or book a service through our website, we collect payment information, billing details, and contact data necessary to complete the transaction. Payments are processed securely through our third-party providers, and we do not store your full payment card information on our servers.
You may provide personal data when you:
Create an account or subscribe to our blog
Book services or purchase a plan
Name, email, phone number, and mailing address
When you visit our Site, we may collect:
IP address, browser type, and operating system
Device and usage analytics via cookies or pixels
Social media platforms, when you connect or share

During Client Services While performing services, we may process data you provide to us, which can include sensitive business information such as strategic plans, financial data, customer lists, system credentials, or employee information for the purposes of analysis and training. This data is governed by the Confidentiality clause in our Terms & Conditions and is used exclusively to fulfill our contractual obligations.

To Deliver Our Services: This includes processing transactions, managing projects, and providing the core services you have engaged us for, such as developing a Claris FileMaker application, providing strategic analysis as a Fractional CTO, or using business data to develop and customize AI frameworks as outlined in a Statement of Work.
Send marketing materials (if you opt in)
Detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized access
Comply with laws and enforce our terms
Where required by law (e.g., under GDPR), we process data based on:
We may share your information with:
Vendors and service providers (hosting, analytics, payment, email delivery)
Regulators and legal authorities, when required
Business partners during mergers or acquisitions

With Third-Party AI Platforms or APIs, only when necessary to perform AI Enablement services and as explicitly agreed upon in a Statement of Work. We will take commercially reasonable steps to anonymize data where possible and will ensure such platforms meet our security standards.
We do not sell your personal information.

TLS/SSL encryption for all web traffic
Encryption at rest for sensitive data

Regular security audits and vulnerability scans
Role-based access controls and data minimization
Continuous monitoring and incident response procedures
Our cybersecurity framework aligns with NIST and ISO 27001 best practices.

Vendor due diligence for compliance assurance
Our Site and services are not intended for children under 13. If we learn that we collected data from a child without parental consent, we will delete it promptly.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updates will be posted with a revised “Last Updated” date, and significant changes will be communicated through email or site notices.
